subject: Recovery readiness artefacts and sign‑off for Ardant Bank tabletop
messages:
From: Sara Lewis <sara.lewis@ardentbank.com>
To: connor_obrien@redwood.com
Cc: security@ardentbank.com
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Recovery rehearsal artifacts and warm-cache verification request

Connor —

Thanks again for hosting last week’s tabletop for Ardant Bank. The execs want a concise packet we can attach to our SOC2 evidence folder. Can you please provide the following by EOD Friday:

- The final tabletop playbook you executed (versioned).
- Proof that the KV cache was exercised during the rehearsal (timestamps and warm‑start verification).
- Aggregate timing showing failover recovery windows observed (we track both service RTO and state RPO).
- Any open actions and the owner for each item.

We’d like to confirm that Redwood’s warm-cache behavior is consistent with the TRW we discussed — in particular how long prefix/KV warming takes for a 2M token model in the Dedicated pool, and how that translates to observed input latency for the first 50 requests after a warm restart.

Let me know if you need more detail on the format. If you can supply a single ZIP with the artifacts and a short one‑page exec summary, that would be ideal.

Thanks,
Sara Lewis
Head of Security Operations
Ardant Bank

From: connor_obrien@redwood.com
To: Sara Lewis <sara.lewis@ardentbank.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recovery rehearsal artifacts and warm-cache verification request

Hi Sara —

Appreciate the clear list. We’ll assemble the packet and include a short executive summary as requested. Plan:

1) Monica will gather the tabletop playbook and action log (owner assignments).
2) Rishi will pull the KV cache exercise logs and compute the warm-start/first-50-requests latency profile.
3) I’ll compile a one‑page summary mapping the observed numbers to Ardant’s RTO/RPO thresholds and call out items that need follow-up.

Deliverable ETA: Friday 2027-01-22 EOD PT. If we can deliver earlier we will.

Quick question for clarity: when you say “2M token model in the Dedicated pool” — do you want the numbers only for the Dedicated pool instance we used during the rehearsal (ded-nyc-3), or also for the hosted fallback instance we exercised (hosted-west-1 small-quant)? We can include both but it will add a morning of analysis.

Connor O’Brien
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: monica_patel@redwood.com
To: Sara Lewis <sara.lewis@ardentbank.com>, connor_obrien@redwood.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 19 Jan 2027 11:26:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recovery rehearsal artifacts and warm-cache verification request

Sara / Connor —

Attached: 20270118-tabletop-playbook.pdf — this is the final playbook used during the exercise; it includes the scenario, roles, and the minute-by-minute script. Also attached is the action-log excerpt that lists 6 follow-ups (owners and target dates). Highlights:

- Escalation lead: Vanessa Ortiz — coordinate with Ardant on runbook integration (action #3).
- Verify KMS key rotation window: action #5 (Ops to confirm rotation freeze during DR drills).

I’ve also included a short readme in the ZIP describing file contents. Rishi — will you confirm which compute pools you plan to include in the warm-start summary?

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachments: 20270118-tabletop-playbook.pdf (application/pdf), action-log-ardant-20270118.csv (text/csv)

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: Sara Lewis <sara.lewis@ardentbank.com>, connor_obrien@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 21 Jan 2027 08:41:00 -0800
Subject: Warm-start and failover timings — data pull and summary

Sara —

I pulled the rehearsal telemetry and produced three artifacts:

1) kv-cache-warmup-snapshot.csv — time‑series of KV cache rebuild events (UTC timestamps), entry counts, and measured warm-up completion times. Sample rows included in the CSV:
   2027-01-18T16:03:21Z, ded-nyc-3, 1842387, warmup_complete, 00:01:22
   2027-01-18T16:03:50Z, hosted-west-1, 1842387, warmup_complete, 00:02:15

2) warmstart-latency-summary.xlsx — aggregated percentiles for first-50 requests after a warm restart, per-pool. Key findings:
   - ded-nyc-3 (2M token model): median first-50-req latency = 170ms, p95 = 440ms
   - hosted-west-1 (small-quant fallback): median first-50-req latency = 320ms, p95 = 820ms

3) short log excerpt in the ZIP showing the exact request IDs used to compute the sample (for your auditors).

Notes / interpretation:
- The Dedicated pool hit the target recovery window for interactive workloads (sub-500ms median) after the in-memory KV restored (~1m22s).
- The hosted fallback demonstrated correct graceful degradation but a longer tail during the first-minute post-restart.
- RPO for session state (payload checkpoints) was within the 60s window we discussed — there were no lost checkpoints during the rehearsal, confirmed by sequence numbers.

Open items (from the telemetry):
- Action 2: increase KV rebuild parallelism in ded-nyc-3 for warm-starts larger than 1.5M entries (owner: rishi_malhotra, target: 2027-02-04).
- Action 4: ops to confirm snapshot retention policy covers 30 days for rehearsal evidence (owner: vanessa_ortiz, target: 2027-01-28).

I’ve attached the three files to the ZIP we’ll hand over. If you want raw traces instead of the CSV/XLSX summaries, I can provide a redacted tarball with trace IDs.

– Rishi
Lead Site Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachments: kv-cache-warmup-snapshot.csv (text/csv), warmstart-latency-summary.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Sara Lewis <sara.lewis@ardentbank.com>
To: connor_obrien@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 22 Jan 2027 16:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recovery readiness artefacts and sign‑off for Ardant Bank tabletop

Connor / Team —

Thanks for the packet and the clear summary. I reviewed the playbook and the warmstart numbers — they map cleanly to what our auditors expect. A few quick notes:

- The ded-nyc-3 median and p95 numbers are acceptable. We will include the CSV/XLSX in our SOC2 evidence bundle.
- Action 2 (KV rebuild parallelism) should be tracked as a security remit item; I’ll triage internally and follow up if we need a formal change control ticket.
- We confirm sign-off on the rehearsal artifacts for SOC2 attachment. Please attach the signed acknowledgement (we require a one-page customer-ack signoff).

Attached is a single page signoff we completed (signoff-ardant-20270122.pdf). Consider this acceptance for the 2027-01-18 exercise.

Appreciate the responsiveness — closing this item on our side.

Best,
Sara Lewis
Head of Security Operations
Ardant Bank
Attachments: signoff-ardant-20270122.pdf (application/pdf)
